blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Port Moody total for houses that month.

blocks.text: North Shore Port Moody Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: North Shore is a board sub-area name, not a City neighbourhood name: the City's Official Community Plan (OCP) areas on this shore are Pleasantside and April Road, plus Ioco and the Heritage Mountain grouping.
The house strip runs along the north shore of Burrard Inlet on Ioco Road, Alderside Road, Bentley Road, April Road and Barber Street, with Burrard Inlet to the south and the Ioco lands to the west.

blocks.text: North Shore Port Moody Houses: the housing stock

items.t: Pleasantside Elementary at 195 Barber Street is the in-area school building anchoring the Barber Street and April Road house streets.

blocks.text: North Shore Port Moody Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Small-lot subdivision to RS1-S, minimum 9 metres width and 325 square metres, is available in Pleasantside where the Official Community Plan designates Single Family – Low Density — Pleasantside is one of only three areas named for it, with Moody Centre and Seaview.

blocks.text: North Shore Port Moody Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Old Orchard Hall at 646 Bentley Road is the in-area community hall, and Official Community Plan policy promotes it for community events and childcare.
Barber Street Park at 94 April Road is the small neighbourhood playground inside the April Road house streets.
The Old Orchard Park Master Plan was endorsed by Council in 2024 and guides park work over a three- to five-year period, so beach and hall facilities here are mid-renewal, not finished.
No recreation complex or library branch sits on this shore: the Port Moody Recreation Complex is at 300 Ioco Road south of the inlet side, and the single Public Library is at 100 Newport Drive.

blocks.text: North Shore Port Moody Houses: getting around

items.t: Route 181, Moody Centre Station / Ioco, runs this shore on Ioco Road via Murray Street and the Moody overpass, with some trips starting from Belcarra.
Route 182, Belcarra / Moody Centre Station, also runs Murray Street and Ioco Road before turning onto Heritage Mountain Boulevard toward Anmore and Belcarra.
The Shoreline Trail runs along this shore between Old Orchard Park and Rocky Point Park and Inlet Park, giving the house streets a waterfront walking and cycling link the hillside areas do not have.

blocks.text: North Shore Port Moody Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check Development Permit Area 4 (Environmentally Sensitive Areas) and Area 5 (Hazardous Lands and Steep Slopes) before buying a shore or slope lot, using the City ViewPort Environmentally Sensitive Areas and Watercourses layers.
Check heritage status in the Ioco townsite before planning work: it is a heritage conservation area, and the general zoning page does not settle a specific house's permit position.

Check the foreshore lot against the City hazards page: the Official Community Plan names flooding, erosion and landslip among Port Moody hazards, and a shoreline address needs its own check, not a neighbourhood assurance.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in North Shore (Port Moody)?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 17 houses listed in North Shore (Port Moody). That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is North Shore (Port Moody) a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in North Shore (Port Moody) had a sales ratio of 6%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in North Shore (Port Moody) from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 3 houses sold in North Shore (Port Moody) over those 5 months, out of 64 in all of Port Moody.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in North Shore (Port Moody)?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: Which elementary school serves a Bentley Road house?
faq.a: Pleasantside Elementary at 195 Barber Street is the elementary school in this shore area, and a School District No. Middle school returned both Eagle Mountain Middle and École Moody Middle, so confirm the exact address.

faq.q: Is there a beach for north shore house owners?
faq.a: Yes, at Old Orchard Park, 630 Alderside Road. The City and its parks master-plan work describe Old Orchard Park as holding Port Moody's only swimming beach, with the Shoreline Trail starting there toward Rocky Point Park at the head of the inlet.

faq.q: Can I split a Pleasantside lot into small lots?
faq.a: Possibly, and only in Pleasantside on this shore. The City allows subdivision from RS1 to the small-lot RS1-S zone, minimum 9 metres width and 325 square metres per lot, only where the Official Community Plan designates Single Family – Low Density in Moody Centre, Seaview and Pleasantside.

faq.q: Is there a SkyTrain station on the north shore?
faq.a: No station is on this shore. Buses 181 and 182 run the Ioco Road corridor to Moody Centre Station, which carries both the Millennium Line and the West Coast Express. A north shore house commute therefore always starts with a bus leg or a drive down Ioco Road.
